newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 3.38 bln Ffr of BTANs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 3.38 bln Ffr of BTANs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold
a further 3.38 billion francs of BTANs after Thursday's auction,
increasing the total value of bonds sold to 27.195 billion.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell between 22 and 24 billion francs of BTANs in total.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
